description: RefactorBench style (behaviour-preserving refactor): extract all user-facing wording of a small Python CLI (argparse help texts, success and error lines, statistics, a singular/plural summary) into a new messages catalog module. Output must stay byte-identical (protected tests compare stdout, stderr and exit codes), and a protected checks script scans the CLI module's AST for any remaining message literal, including the bare plural noun, and verifies the catalog really holds the wording.
